description: Core behavioral requirements for retained authentication, approval credential lifetimes, governed principal names and constrained issuer authority, evidence and response audiences, including the approved exact retained expired-retry rule. Abstract traces, not executed actor conformance. Unless a trace says otherwise, the response route is independently assured for its recipient and current disclosure authorization permits the stated response. Generic WebSocket rejection means code 1008 without a reason or application message that reveals a retained disposition; these traces do not claim constant-time processing or eliminate every timing side channel. Issuer and name assignments in these traces are example governance policy, not a configuration format, network-prefix requirement or federation service. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.

cases.name: a timely decision outlives the original approval certificate

steps.event: O issues approval P while its credential is valid, retaining exact bytes, valid issuance basis and deadline T3; A authenticates P at T0 before credential expiry T1
expect: O owns pending P
A retains its own authentication observation
neither issuance nor authentication alone grants permission

steps.event: At T2 where T1 is past and T2 < T3, A sends a new currently authenticated and authorized decide D bound to P
expect: verify D using current admission rules
use O's retained original P without requiring its credential to remain unexpired
accept one decision and issue owner closure
P bytes and digest remain unchanged

cases.name: issuance knowledge is distinct from peer receipt

steps.event: O signs valid P and retains its issuance basis, but delivery to A is lost
expect: O may retain pending P until its deadline
O cannot claim A authenticated or accepted P

steps.event: A later first receives P after its credential expires
expect: certificate-expired under first-seen admission
O's local issuance knowledge is not A's prior authentication observation
no permission is inferred

cases.name: credential renewal signs new decisions without rewriting the request

steps.event: A authenticates P then renews its own credential with the same key
expect: retain P's original bytes and authentication basis

steps.event: A signs new D with the renewed currently valid credential; O authorizes A and receives D before P's deadline
expect: D can bind P's original digest
no re-signing of P is needed

cases.name: authorized message-key rotation preserves principal decision policy

steps.event: A authenticates P under its existing exchange; its decision key is then rotated under the applicable identity policy
expect: key rotation alone does not replace P or create decision authority

steps.event: A sends D with a new key currently certified for the same authorized principal; O verifies identity, current authority, digest and pending deadline
expect: accept D if all current policy checks pass
do not require A's new message key to be P's signing key or its own previous key

cases.name: a fresh expired decision cannot borrow request authentication

steps.event: O retains authenticated/validly issued P; new decide D arrives with an expired credential
expect: certificate-expired
retained P supplies no exception for new D
P remains subject to its own pending/deadline state

cases.name: sender time does not manufacture earlier authentication

steps.event: A first sees expired approval P with sent_at before certificate expiry and an otherwise future approval deadline
expect: certificate-expired
sent_at does not prove earlier receipt or admissible historical existence
do not retain it as a newly accepted approval

cases.name: same scoped ID with different signed bytes is conflicting reuse

steps.event: O and A retain P with digest H; P is re-signed under a refreshed certificate with the same ID and identical decoded payload
expect: new compact JWS is not P's original object
do not substitute the new bytes for H

steps.event: The re-signed frame passes current authentication in P's retained identity/context scope
expect: malformed for conflicting signed-object reuse
preserve original P and prior disposition

cases.name: approval replacement has its own lifecycle

steps.event: O needs to replace issued approval P with a revised or freshly signed proposal Q
expect: Q uses a new message ID and its own deadline and pending state
P is not implicitly rewritten or withdrawn

steps.event: O no longer needs P and explicitly withdraws it
expect: owner closure withdraws P under P03
a later decision for P cannot grant Q

cases.name: context loss does not recreate a pending approval

steps.event: O loses P's pending state and trusted issuance basis in provisioned C1
expect: retire C1's local guard before further admission
no stale C1 frame can recreate P

steps.event: An original decision D signed for C1 is presented to its retired guard or a fresh C2 connection
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame

steps.event: Separately, properly provisioned C2 has no P; a new currently authenticated decision D2 signed for C2 names P
expect: refusal unknown for D2
D2 cannot recreate P or its authentication basis

steps.event: A lost its received P state; an expired original C1 copy is presented after retirement
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame
do not invent an eligible exact-copy authentication basis from the frame

steps.event: Separately, fresh approval P2 signed for active authorized C2 uses the expired credential and has no eligible retained exact-copy basis
expect: ordinary first-seen verification rejects P2 as certificate-expired
do not invent an earlier authentication observation or transplant P's lost basis into C2

cases.name: retained authentication is scoped to exact recipient and context

steps.event: A has authenticated P in context C between O and A; another participant or context C2 presents its ID or bytes
expect: do not transplant P's state into C2 or another principal's context
original signed recipient and context are unchanged
no cross-context decision authority

cases.name: deadline and terminal decisions remain authoritative

steps.event: P is pending with deadline T; D arrives at or after T with sent_at < T and current valid credentials
expect: expire P on O's current clock
closed
sender time does not reopen P

steps.event: A different valid D arrives after P was withdrawn or another decision was accepted
expect: closed
preserve original terminal state

cases.name: current authority is distinct from earlier authentication

steps.event: A authenticated P earlier, but O's policy now removes A's decision authority before a new D arrives
expect: authenticate D under current credential rules
not-authorized if A no longer may decide P
do not treat prior authentication as cached permission

steps.event: O later attempts an effect under an accepted grant
expect: effect owner checks grant validity, use and applicable resource policy
accepted approval does not prove or require execution

cases.name: historical first inspection is not live retained verification

steps.event: V first encounters signed P and D after their credentials expire, with no applicable historical trust agreement
expect: mathematical signature checks alone do not establish historical admissibility
report unestablished evidence in an authorized inspection contract

steps.event: An operation requires that evidence as authority
expect: not-authorized if required authentication cannot be established
no effect under an invented earlier timestamp

cases.name: captured frames cannot establish a confidential response route

steps.event: X presents captured valid signed request S on a connection not assured for S's signer
expect: do not register the connection as the signer's protected return route
do not disclose cached, new or queued application content

steps.event: S would require protected response delivery and no authorized audience route can be established
expect: reject the delivery at the binding boundary before admission; WebSocket closes with code 1008
do not record a terminal refusal or reserve the signed message ID
connection failure is not sender-visible proof of non-execution

steps.event: An already accepted exchange later loses route assurance
expect: hold protected traffic and report delivery uncertainty
do not redirect it to X

steps.event: The legitimate signer later delivers identical S on an assured authorized route with current admission conditions satisfied
expect: earlier unassured delivery created no poisoned disposition
process according to normal first-seen message rules

cases.name: authentication retention cannot be silently evicted

steps.event: A has a valid scope but cannot retain the authentication and disposition state needed to accept P
expect: busy before acceptance
no claim of responsibility that cannot be retained

steps.event: While P is retained, infrastructure considers evicting its required basis to enforce resource limits
expect: do not selectively clear the record while claiming the scope remains live
retain the required state or genuinely retire the defined scope before discarding it

steps.event: A detects loss of previously accepted state under keel.provisioned-context.v1
expect: invalidate the local guard before any replacement state or further admission
close the connection and disable old-scope conversation traffic
do not claim retained continuity or invent first-seen expiry exceptions

cases.name: a terminal semantic refusal stays terminal after the condition changes

steps.event: Currently authenticated request S names an unsupported operation on an assured route; receiver retains terminal refusal in S's proper identity/context scope
expect: unsupported
no work accepted

steps.event: The receiver later adds that operation and receives exact S again while ordinary admission succeeds
expect: repeat established minimal unsupported disposition
no new execution
a new attempt requires a new signed message ID

steps.event: An unauthenticated frame or busy response is encountered
expect: does not create a terminal disposition for S or reserve another principal's ID

cases.name: an exact expired accepted request receives only a fresh minimal acknowledgement

steps.event: A retains accepted request S's exact compact bytes, trusted successful authentication and scoped disposition; S's credential and its original acknowledgement's credential later expire
expect: ordinary expiry does not erase the earlier acceptance
retained state creates no new action authority

steps.event: Identical S arrives within retained context on an independently assured recipient route with current disclosure authorization
expect: confirm full compact-byte equality and the retained profile, principal, recipient and context scope
return a new minimal ack signed with currently admissible response credentials and correlated to S
do not replay the expired old acknowledgement or return taken, result, description, evidence, detail, metadata or application data
do not execute, reopen a turn, advance an approval or issue a second closure transition

cases.name: an exact expired terminally refused request preserves its old refusal

steps.event: A retains an authenticated terminal unsupported refusal for S; S's credential expires and A later offers the operation
expect: S remains terminally refused within its retained scope

steps.event: Exact S is retried on an independently assured route with current disclosure authorization
expect: return a new currently signed minimal refusal with the established unsupported reason and correlation to S
omit old detail, evidence, metadata and application data
do not accept S as a new operation or overwrite the retained refusal
a new attempt requires a fresh signed message ID and ordinary current admission

cases.name: an expired duplicate of an accepted decision remains accepted after the deadline

steps.event: O accepted D for pending P before P's deadline and retained D, P and their decided disposition; the deadline and D's credential expiry are now past
expect: P remains decided under its originally accepted decision
later expiry does not replace the terminal disposition

steps.event: Exact D arrives again on an independently assured route with current disclosure authorization
expect: return only a fresh currently signed minimal ack for the established acceptance
do not return closed merely because the approval deadline is now past
do not accept another decision, confer another grant use or repeat the owner closure transition

steps.event: A different currently admissible decision names terminal P
expect: apply ordinary P03 rules and refuse as closed
preserve P's original accepted decision

cases.name: exact expired acknowledgement and refusal controls do not create response loops

steps.event: A retains a previously handled ack K and later receives identical K after K's credential expires
expect: ignore the repeated control without another delivery-state transition
do not acknowledge an acknowledgement or emit a duplicate-response refusal

steps.event: A retains a previously handled control refusal F and later receives identical F after its credential expires
expect: ignore the repeated control without applying its disposition again
do not acknowledge or answer the refusal
do not confuse a received refusal control with the retained refusal disposition of a request

cases.name: prior busy is not an expired-retry disposition

steps.event: A authenticated S but returned busy without accepting S or retaining a terminal semantic refusal
expect: successful authentication alone supplies no accepted or terminal disposition

steps.event: Exact S arrives after its credential expires, even though A now has capacity and remembers the prior busy attempt
expect: do not use the retained-disposition exception
apply ordinary current admission and return certificate-expired
do not execute S or invent prior acceptance

cases.name: an unassured expired-retry route reveals no retained disposition

steps.event: X presents an expired exact frame on a route not independently assured for its signed response recipient; consider retained accepted, retained terminally refused and no eligible retained-disposition states
expect: use the same generic WebSocket rejection with code 1008 for these cases
send no ack, core refusal, close reason or application message exposing acceptance, refusal, absence of a record or the historical refusal reason
do not disclose cached, queued or new protected content
do not reserve the signed ID, overwrite its disposition or register X's route for its signer

steps.event: The original signer later retries the same bytes on an independently assured route with current disclosure authorization
expect: the earlier rejected delivery did not poison or change retained state
a retained accepted or terminally refused request may receive only its fresh minimal disposition control
a frame with no eligible retained disposition still requires ordinary current admission

cases.name: route assurance without current disclosure authorization reveals no disposition

steps.event: An independently assured route presents an expired frame, but current policy does not permit disclosure of its disposition; consider retained accepted, retained refused and no eligible record states
expect: use the same generic WebSocket rejection with code 1008
do not return an ack, prior refusal reason, not-authorized core status, record-existence hint or protected content
preserve any previous disposition without creating acceptance or a terminal semantic refusal for this delivery

steps.event: Current disclosure permission is later restored while the exact trusted record remains retained
expect: authorized minimal disposition reporting may resume under the exact-retry rule
the earlier disclosure denial did not undo acceptance or authorize a new action

cases.name: current action denial does not rewrite earlier acceptance or require its disclosure

steps.event: A retains accepted S but policy now denies new performance of its action; disclosure of S's prior disposition remains authorized on the assured route
expect: exact expired S may receive a fresh minimal ack reporting only its prior acceptance
do not perform a new action or claim that an effect occurred
current policy governs any still-pending effect or separately requested grant use

steps.event: The caller sends a new currently authenticated request for that action under a new ID
expect: apply current action authorization and refuse as not-authorized
S's earlier acceptance is not a permission cache for the new request

steps.event: Policy also denies disclosure of S's prior disposition
expect: use generic WebSocket rejection with code 1008 for the expired retry
do not report the retained acceptance or alter it

cases.name: altered bytes cannot borrow the expiry exception from a known ID

steps.event: A retains exact accepted S; a frame claims the same principal, context and ID but changes a signed part and carries an expired credential
expect: no exact-byte match and no retained-authentication exception
apply current verification order rather than trusting the claimed principal or ID
certificate-expired wins if it is the first ordinary verification failure
do not disclose or overwrite S's disposition on the basis of the claimed ID

steps.event: Different signed bytes for S's same scope and ID instead pass all current authentication checks
expect: refuse as malformed for conflicting signed-object reuse
preserve S's original bytes and disposition

cases.name: a frame-index hit is confirmed by full bytes and trusted scope

steps.event: An index lookup returns a retained candidate for incoming frame X because of a hash/index collision or candidate mismatch; the complete compact byte strings differ
expect: reject the candidate as an exact match after full-byte comparison
do not return its prior disposition or use its authentication basis for X
subject X to ordinary current admission if no other exact eligible record matches

steps.event: Bytes match an artifact held only under another recipient, profile or lost context, without this receiver's eligible live disposition
expect: do not transplant its authentication or disposition into the receiving scope
an index hit does not establish context continuity or recipient authority

cases.name: inspection or issuance knowledge is not an accepted incoming disposition

steps.event: A previously authenticated signed P only as attached evidence, without accepting it as an incoming approval exchange; O also retains its own issuance record
expect: neither evidence inspection nor O's issuance record proves A accepted P
do not create pending approval state or an acceptance disposition from those facts

steps.event: P first arrives for request handling after its credential expires
expect: the retained-disposition exception does not apply
ordinary current admission returns certificate-expired
do not emit an acknowledgement asserting prior acceptance or create a new approval

cases.name: a minimal retained-disposition response still needs current signing credentials

steps.event: An exact expired accepted request qualifies for disposition reporting on an assured authorized route, but the receiver has no currently admissible response-signing credential
expect: do not replay an expired cached acknowledgement or send an unsigned substitute
preserve the earlier acceptance without executing again
report local delivery uncertainty; the peer cannot infer a new acknowledgement from silence

steps.event: The receiver obtains a current credential and exact S is retried while its record remains retained and disclosure remains authorized
expect: return only the freshly signed minimal disposition permitted by the rule

cases.name: an expired accepted describe retry confirms only prior acceptance

steps.event: A retains an accepted actor-level describe request S within its required duplicate window; identical S is retried after S's credential expires on an assured authorized route
expect: return only a fresh minimal actor-level ack correlated to S under the expired-retry exception
do not replay or generate a description through this exception
the ack establishes prior acceptance, not delivery of a description or permission to inspect current capabilities

steps.event: The requester needs a current description
expect: use a new currently admissible describe request under the ordinary authorization and response-audience rules

cases.name: response-audience preflight hides whether an expired frame is retained

steps.event: An unassured route presents expired E1 with an exact retained acceptance and expired E2 with no eligible record; both are otherwise well-framed
expect: apply the independent route and current disclosure preflight before any state-dependent or expiry diagnostic is returned
both deliveries close WebSocket with code 1008 and no informative close reason or core message
do not return ack for E1 or certificate-expired for E2
neither delivery changes a retained disposition or reserves an ID
equal permitted outputs do not constitute a claim of constant-time processing

steps.event: Repeat the comparison on an independently assured route whose current policy denies disposition disclosure, and with E1 instead terminally refused or either frame still within credential validity
expect: the same generic code 1008 rejection precedes any acceptance, prior-refusal, expiry or record-existence feedback
known versus unknown and expired versus currently admissible frames cannot select different core status responses before the preflight permits disclosure

steps.event: Bounded parsing exposes untrusted principal/context selectors before authentication, or a frame claims another principal's already assured route policy
expect: selectors may only select or narrow an existing independently established policy; they confer no identity, route ownership or disclosure permission
require the trusted retained scope or subsequently authenticated scope to agree with the policy used for the route
if assurance cannot be established, use the same generic binding rejection without consulting a historical disposition to grant access

steps.event: The route is independently assured and its current policy permits the applicable diagnostic; a first-seen malformed frame arrives
expect: ordinary bounded framing and verification diagnostics remain available under the permitted disclosure policy
the diagnostic does not use an unauthenticated claimed ID to reveal a stored disposition

cases.name: actor credentials require authority over the governed actor name

steps.event: The receiver's governed name assignment identifies actor:release; its explicit policy permits IssuerA to certify that actor and recognizes IssuerA's verification key
expect: an otherwise valid current IssuerA credential for actor:release passes the issuer-name authority check
the authenticated principal remains actor:release, not an issuer-qualified replacement
operation authorization still applies independently

steps.event: IssuerA signs an otherwise valid credential for actor:deployment outside its permitted naming authority
expect: certificate-invalid at the certificate validation step
a trusted signing key does not authorize IssuerA to certify every actor name

steps.event: IssuerA is authorized for actor:release but has no authority for actor:Release or party:release
expect: credentials for those other full strings fail the naming-authority check as certificate-invalid
compare kind and case exactly; spelling similarity supplies no additional naming scope

cases.name: party credentials require authority over the governed party name

steps.event: The receiver recognizes party:owner as a governed participant and explicitly permits IssuerH to certify that party with its configured key
expect: an otherwise valid current credential passes the issuer-name authority check for party:owner
the principal is party:owner; no mandatory network or issuer prefix is added
the credential alone grants no actor operation or approval authority

steps.event: IssuerH presents a valid signature over a credential for party:other that it is not authorized to certify
expect: certificate-invalid
party identities have the same explicit naming-authority requirement as actor identities

cases.name: two trusted issuers cannot independently capture the same governed subject

steps.event: IssuerA and IssuerB have trusted verification keys; only IssuerA is authorized over actor:release, while IssuerB has authority over other names
expect: IssuerA's otherwise valid actor:release credential passes this check
IssuerB's otherwise valid credential with the same sub actor:release fails as certificate-invalid
do not inherit actor:release permissions, retained contexts or history through IssuerB's unauthorized assertion

steps.event: IssuerB claims that an unrelated network independently assigned actor:release to another participant
expect: the remote assignment does not override the receiver's governed identity mapping
reject the unauthorized naming claim instead of silently merging participants or treating issuer-qualified identities as the core principal model

cases.name: two issuers may deliberately certify the same governed participant

steps.event: Governance deliberately authorizes IssuerA and IssuerB to certify the same participant actor:release, with their respective allowed verification keys
expect: otherwise valid current credentials from either issuer can authenticate that same actor:release principal
retain the actual issuer, actual verifying issuer key and certified message key in each authentication basis
the overlap is an explicit identity mapping, not two unrelated actors acquiring one name

steps.event: Messages certified by the two allowed issuers use the same principal and retained context
expect: ordinary current action authorization and message identity rules apply
changing issuer does not create a fresh duplicate namespace or permit conflicting reuse of the same scoped message ID

cases.name: adding a trust anchor grants no automatic naming authority

steps.event: An operator adds IssuerC's authentic verification key to trust configuration without granting IssuerC authority over actor:release or party:owner
expect: first-seen credentials from IssuerC for either existing name fail as certificate-invalid
verification-key trust is not a wildcard naming grant
existing participants' contexts and permissions are unchanged

steps.event: Governance subsequently grants IssuerC explicit authority over the existing party:owner identity and no actor names
expect: an otherwise valid current party:owner credential can pass the naming check under the new policy
actor:release remains outside IssuerC's authority
the naming change does not itself authorize a party operation or confer network membership

cases.name: key and issuer rotation preserve a name only through deliberate authority mapping

steps.event: Governance retains the participant actor:release while explicitly replacing or overlapping its issuer verification keys and allowing a current credential for its rotated message key
expect: the principal name can remain actor:release under the deliberate mapping
new frames require currently permitted issuer keys, naming authority and certified message-key binding
retained old messages keep their original bytes, issuer, actual verifying issuer key, certified message key and verification basis

steps.event: A different issuer attempts to certify actor:release merely because its key is trusted or it claims to replace the old issuer
expect: certificate-invalid unless governance explicitly grants that issuer authority over the same participant
a credential or sender assertion cannot perform the governance transition itself

steps.event: The replacement issuer is deliberately authorized over that same identity
expect: otherwise valid current new credentials can authenticate actor:release without renaming it
issuing a replacement does not by itself revoke old credentials; current issuer/name/key policy and expiry determine their new-message admissibility

steps.event: Two keys share the configured issuer name IssuerA, but only key K1 is authorized for actor:release; a credential for that name verifies under K2
expect: certificate-invalid even though both keys are trusted under IssuerA
do not combine K2's valid signature with K1's naming authority
the allowed association is the actual issuer name, verifying issuer key and subject together

cases.name: network membership and operation permission do not define principal identity

steps.event: The same governed actor:release or party:owner participates in two networks that deliberately recognize its identity but have different admission and operation policies
expect: the principal need not acquire a mandatory network-prefixed name
recognition of identity does not automatically confer membership or operation permission in either network
each receiver applies its current membership and resource policy separately from credential naming checks

steps.event: One network removes that participant's permission to perform a new application action, while its identity credential, profile membership, provisioned scope and disclosure authorization remain valid
expect: deny the affected new action as not-authorized
do not silently rename the participant, erase prior effects or transfer its identity to another participant

steps.event: Separately, membership or authorization to use a provisioned scope is withdrawn, or current policy denies disposition disclosure
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame
retire the local guard when its provisioned authorization is lost
withholding feedback does not erase principal identity or retained historical facts

cases.name: a genuine principal rename does not merge permissions or retained history

steps.event: Governance assigns actor:publisher as a new principal name where the participant previously used actor:release
expect: new messages authenticate under their actual certified name
core does not infer aliasing or equality merely from the same key, issuer, operator or asserted rename
old signed frames remain attributed and addressed under their original names

steps.event: actor:publisher presents an old message ID, approval reference or history location belonging to actor:release
expect: do not silently transplant prior permissions, grant-holder identity, retained contexts, duplicate dispositions or history access
any authorized migration or new access follows an explicit applicable policy without rewriting old signed bytes or inventing prior receipt
a new name alone cannot accept a decision for an old principal's lost or unowned approval

cases.name: reused spelling cannot repurpose a governed principal or cross namespace isolation

steps.event: An operator retires a participant and attempts to assign actor:release to a different participant while continuing to interpret it as the same governed principal
expect: do not repurpose the same governed principal or treat spelling as proof of participant continuity
ending the old conversation or clearing duplicate state does not make its old permissions, signed evidence or history belong to the replacement
use a distinct governed name or a genuinely separate isolated namespace instead of inheriting the old identity

steps.event: A separate namespace legitimately uses actor:release for a different participant under an independently established binding/deployment context
expect: scope its trust, issuer/key naming authority, principal resolution, authorization, pending exchanges, grants, duplicate records and historical interpretation independently
no namespace discriminator or mandatory prefix is inferred in the core wire name
an untrusted sender claim or metadata cannot switch the namespace selected by that independently established context

steps.event: That different participant presents captured old-namespace approval or request bytes on a route assured only for the separate namespace's actor:release
expect: the route is not thereby authorized for the retained original participant/context
do not use old-namespace trust or authentication records to admit the frame or disclose its old disposition
use generic binding rejection with no retained-status disclosure when the old context's current audience authorization is absent
any first-seen admission remains confined to the independently selected namespace's own issuer/key/name and authorization policy

cases.name: issuer-policy changes preserve authentication facts without caching current authority

steps.event: O validly issues approval P under then-authorized IssuerA, A authenticates it, and both retain their proper basis; governance later removes IssuerA's naming authority for new admissions while preserving the governed participants
expect: retain the original issuance and receipt facts with their actual issuer, actual verifying issuer key, certified message key and policy basis
the policy change does not rewrite P's signed bytes or automatically establish that it was never issued or received
first-seen new frames relying on the now-unauthorized issuer/name binding fail as certificate-invalid

steps.event: Current trust and action policy still permits the pending approval to continue; before P's deadline, A sends D with currently admissible naming authority and current decision permission
expect: apply P04 using O's retained exact P and valid original issuance basis
accept the valid bound decision without requiring P to be re-signed or its old certificate to regain current admissibility
do not use P's old authentication to admit any fresh frame from IssuerA

steps.event: Current policy instead denies a new decision, further grant use or disclosure of a prior disposition
expect: enforce the applicable current denial without inventing a different historical acceptance or effect
a retained exact-copy response still requires independent original-recipient route assurance and current disclosure authorization
denied disclosure uses the uniform generic WebSocket 1008 rejection, with no known-versus-unknown status leak
